methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked; any method behaves like GET (body ignored).

auth.notes: Before the jobId check, so a missing token gives 401 even without jobId.

query.name: jobId
query.parse: searchParams.get('jobId'); no format check (any non-empty string)
query.invalidBehaviour: missing or empty -> 400 'jobId is required'; a non-UUID string is just looked up and, if absent, returns {status:'pending'}

responses.when: job blob not yet written (or never existed)
job.status === 'pending' (or any status other than error/done)

bodyShape.error: string | omitted when job.error is undefined (JSON.stringify drops undefined)

quirks: An unknown jobId returns 200 {status:'pending'}, not 404, so a typo polls forever (quick-status.ts:12).
Ownership is only checked once the job exists; before that anyone gets 'pending'.
slides are sorted by slideNumber by the producer (quick-generate-background.ts:111); the done body has no per-slide partial progress while pending.
`slides` falls back to [] if the done record has none (quick-status.ts:18).
In the error body, `error` is omitted (not null) when the record has no message.
beforeAnyState: 200 {"status":"pending"} for any jobId that has no blob.

tests.asserts: null job -> pending; pending -> pending; done -> slides with url containing '/api/quick-image?jobId=j1&slide=1'; error -> {status:'error', error:'boom'}; other owner -> 403; no jobId -> 400. Does not assert `warnings`.

callers.who: none in Slide-Creator src/ or Auxi_Connector

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:470-517. Discrepancies: the `warnings` array in the done body is not documented; 400/403/401 responses not documented; jobId documented as format uuid but not validated.

planSection65: Row says `{status, slides?, warnings?, error?}`. Accurate, with the correction that `warnings` is always present ([] default) on done, and unknown jobs return pending.
